name: Stochastic Ray-Casting Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization technique that determines if a voxel center is inside a mesh by casting multiple random rays from the voxel center and counting intersections with mesh triangles. It handles non-manifold or broken meshes by using a majority vote over randomized directions rather than a single deterministic ray.
summary: Stochastic Ray-Casting Voxelization determines voxel interior status via probabilistic majority voting of random ray intersections, offering robustness against broken or non-manifold meshes where deterministic single-ray tests fail.
